text:
Alexis: Heads-up — planning a kernel + quant-profile rollout tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Target engine 2.4.0, quant-profile v2.1. No infra changes, just runtime binaries & profile swap. Who can own the window?

Jamie: I can own the deploy window (02:00 UTC). Will pair with oncall for visibility. Any canary slice IDs?

Alexis: Thanks Jamie. Canary slices: slice-5 (low-traffic) then slice-12. Plan is 10m canary, 20m ramp if stable. KV cache disabled for first canary to baseline.

Devon: Quick QA: is there a PR with the kernel shim and profile? Ping me the PR number so I can do a fast review today. Also any config flags to toggle?

Alexis: PR is #7843 (engine: bump + profile). Flag: runtime.experimental_prefetch=false (we keep prefetch off in canary).

Priya: I can run smoke tests and post results. Outline the smoke checklist here and I’ll convert to a script.

Alexis: Smoke checklist (short):
1) /health endpoints on canary hosts return 200 within 150ms
2) 2 sample generation requests (seq len 256) complete < 400ms p50
3) KV/hit-rate metrics observed (should be near 0 for disabled cache)
4) no OOMs in dmesg for 30m
5) perf counter sampler for kernel soft-faults < baseline+10%

Commands for smoke (run from deploy-runner):
```bash
# health
curl -sS http://canary-host-1:8080/health | jq .status
# sample
python tools/smoke/generate_sample.py --host canary-host-1 --seq 256 --n 2
# dmesg check
ssh canary-host-1 sudo dmesg | tail -n 50 | grep -i oom || true
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: job_id=dep-2026-3305001234. ETA 02:00 UTC. Triggers: canary-slice-5 -> canary-slice-12 -> ramp. Notifications to #eng-runtime and oncall.

Maya: Rollback plan: immediate gate to old engine variant (engine:2.3.7) via runtime.route override; rollback command: `redwoodctl rollout revert --to engine:2.3.7 --scope slice-5` — do dry-run earlier to confirm permissions. Also keep quant-profile v2.0 available.

Jamie: I’ll set a 5m hold after canary validation to watch tail logs/metrics. Who will watch the quality regressions? Priya?

Priya: I’ll run the smoke script and a quick eval set (10 prompts) for hallucination/regression. I’ll post a short table in this thread with p50/p95 and pass/fail.

Devon: Reviewed #7843 — minor lint and a logging nit, nothing blocking. I’ll approve after CI green. Please wait for my approval before gating the canary job.

Alexis: Great. Action items: Jamie (deploy owner + hold), Priya (smoke + eval), Devon (final PR approval), Maya (rollback steps tested prewindow). Deploy will not start until Devon approves and Priya posts green smoke.

Maya: I’ll test the rollback command in staging tonight and paste the exact output.

Priya: Copy — will convert smoke checklist to `scripts/smoke/kernel_quant_canary.sh` and run at 01:30 UTC as rehearsal.

Alexis: Perfect. If anything blocks, @devon or @jamie escalate to oncall. Otherwise green-light tomorrow. :thumbsup:
